conditions.hindsight: Same native prompt receives actual future16 for TRAIN label generation only; no deployable-policy interpretation.

controls: Empty plus own, recipient-length matched filler, token permutation and next-global-note donors within each condition.
copy_breakdown_qualification: Post-hoc descriptive subsets only; all16 remain in every primary contrast. Exact token overlap is not a test for semantic copying, paraphrase, shorter matches, or reasoning. No label selection/filtering or inferential subgroup claim.

fixed_examples.selection: First4 fixed anchors by order, no outcome/copy selection; all note/prompt/target text and reader details remain local/EBS.

limitations: TRAIN target-surprisal selected anchors; no held-out utility claim.
Hindsight teacher receives truefuture16 during writing: label-generation information, never deployment evidence.
Prefix-only teacher is external 4B assistance, not 1.7B self-generated reasoning.
All32 notes retained, including empty/capped/over150word notes; no filtering or resampling.
Copying statistics are descriptive and do not change denominators or label selection.
Stronger prefix-only external teacher remains negative atK16 under the same B0 prepend reader.
Hindsight positive utility is label-generation evidence with target access, not deployed prefix-only benefit or evidence of reasoning.
No student learning result, official final test or end-to-end training throughput result is asserted.
